logo.title: The Forward Chevrons.
logo.lead: Two chevrons pointing forward, like road markings: motion, progress and "you're good to go". The mark works on a van, a key fob, an MOT reminder text or a sign on Lea Bridge Road. The wordmark is set in Barlow Condensed, the look of road signage.

story.title: Honest cars, honest work.
story.lead: Driving Force is a family-run garage on Lea Bridge Road, doing MOTs, servicing, repairs and used car sales for more than 25 years, and trusted enough to join Which? Trusted Traders and the Good Garage Scheme. The brand should say one thing clearly: straight-talking, reliable, quick. No grease-monkey clichés and no hard sell.
story.positioning: Walthamstow's family garage: MOTs, servicing and used cars you can trust, from people who'll tell you straight.
story.promise: Straight talk. Quick work. Good to go.

colour.title: Road navy, signal yellow.
colour.lead: Deep road-sign navy for trust and signal yellow for action. It's the colour of MOT pass certificates and road markings. Keep yellow for buttons and the chevrons. Tyre black and light grey support.

type.title: Road-sign condensed, clear sans.
type.lead: Barlow Condensed has the feel of UK road signage: tall, clear and confident. Barlow keeps prices and booking forms easy to read. Both are free on Google Fonts.

samples.label: Body
samples.text: Drop it off in the morning, and we'll call you when it's ready, with no surprises on the bill.

voice.title: Straight talk, no jargon.
voice.lead: Explain what's wrong, what it costs and how long it takes, in plain English. Never pressure. Never scare people about safety to upsell.
pairs: "We'll call you before doing any work that isn't booked."
"Quality Affordable Cheap MOT Used Car Services"

imagery.title: Clean bays, real people.
imagery.lead: The workshop tidy and well lit, the team at work, cars on the ramp, and the forecourt with used stock. Straight-on used-car photos with consistent angles. No stock models in overalls, and no "thumbs up" mechanics.
